# law-ai documentation

> Every document in this repository, one line each — start with the root README, and see AGENTS.md for how to work here.

**Backlog of record:** [BACKLOG.md](../BACKLOG.md), the append-only file backlog declared in `.github/sdlc.yml`. New to the codebase? Read [philosophy.md](philosophy.md), [architecture.md](architecture.md) and [constitution.md](constitution.md) first. Pages under `reference/` are generated from source and say which command rebuilds them.
